mapper.select: SELECT document_id, document_name, keywords FROM documents

SELECT d.document_name AS documentName, CASE WHEN ud.user_document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed FROM required_documents rd JOIN documents d ON rd.document_id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN user_documents ud ON d.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} WHERE rd.policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT d.document_name AS documentName, CASE WHEN ud.user_document_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed FROM required_documents rd JOIN documents d ON rd.document_id = d.document_id LEFT JOIN user_documents ud ON d.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} WHERE rd.loan_id = #{loanId}

SELECT p.policy_name AS name, 'POLICY' AS type, p.supervising_organization_name AS organization, DATEDIFF(p.end_date, CURDATE()) AS dDay, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rd.document_id) FROM required_documents rd JOIN user_documents ud ON rd.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} WHERE rd.policy_id = p.policy_id) AS prepared, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM required_documents WHERE policy_id = p.policy_id) AS required FROM policies p JOIN required_documents rd ON p.policy_id = rd.policy_id WHERE rd.document_id = #{documentId}

SELECT l.product_name AS name, 'LOAN' AS type, l.company_name AS organization, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rd.document_id) FROM required_documents rd JOIN user_documents ud ON rd.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} WHERE rd.loan_id = l.loan_id) AS prepared, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM required_documents WHERE loan_id = l.loan_id) AS required FROM loans l JOIN required_documents rd ON l.loan_id = rd.loan_id WHERE rd.document_id = #{documentId}
